column1: # The port's own translations, unofficial: the US texts the European ROMs have no translation of, written for the port
# in the game's register (config/language_exceptions_*.tsv says which texts take them). A row: a key, a language (en-eu,
# fr, de, it, es), the text. The text is written in the font's characters as UTF-8; \n is a line break, \stop the end of a
# box, \col(N) a colour (N hexadecimal), \\ a backslash, \xNN any other byte. A line holds sixteen characters at most.
